beats.say: 52 countries: Eurovision now has broadcasters from 52 nations joining in.
Germany has competed in every edition except one, more than any other country in the contest's history.
Ireland and Sweden each hold seven victories, the joint highest total in the competition.
So how does the contest actually work for viewers?
The minimum age for participants will rise to 18 in 2027, and the show has been streamed online worldwide since 2000.
Eurovision means 52 nations, one stage and millions sharing one moment every year.

facts: Broadcasters from 52 countries have participated at least once

es.summary: Eurovisión reúne a 52 países, con Alemania compitiendo más, Irlanda y Suecia con más victorias, un cambio de regla de edad en 2027 y transmisión global desde 2000.

pt.title: Eurovisão: a mudança de regra em 2027 🎶
pt.summary: A Eurovisão envolve emissoras de 52 países, com a Alemanha competindo mais, Irlanda e Suécia empatadas em vitórias, mudança de regra de idade em 2027 e transmissão global desde 2000.

hi.title: यूरोविज़न: 2027 में नियम बदलाव 🎶
hi.summary: यूरोविज़न में 52 देशों के प्रसारक शामिल हैं, जर्मनी सबसे अधिक प्रतिस्पर्धा करता है, आयरलैंड और स्वीडन सबसे अधिक जीत के साथ बराबरी पर हैं, 2027 में उम्र का नियम बदलेगा, और 2000 से वैश्विक स्ट्रीमिंग हो रही है।
